description: ThermalLabel Editor Add-on is a first-class barcode label designer component for .NET Core Windows Desktop apps (WinForms & WPF) which empowers your own apps by providing an end-user visual label editor! It features visual aids for the creation of items like texts, barcodes, pictures and shapes; an undo/redo engine, Cut-Copy-Paste functionality, Grid-lines, snap to grid, Z-ordering, zooming, keyboard shortcuts for well-known common actions, In-place text edition for TextItem objects and many more features! It is also very customizable so you can skin it to match the app’s UI style on which it will be hosted in. With the ThermalLabel Editor component, you can allow your end-users to create, load, edit and save ThermalLabel objects in the form of XML template file definition or .NET object within your own .NET apps. You can also export the labels to PDF or raster image formats by leveraging the ThermalLabel SDK ThermalLabel Editor provides First-Class Internationl Barcode Standards compliance. Neodynamic is an expert in the barcode field and all the barcode algorithms were written from ground up based on the official specifications. ThermalLabel Editor leverages the ThermalLabel SDK and provides you and your end-users with barcode generation for most popular Linear (1D), Postal & 2D Symbologies/Standards including Code 39, Code 128, GS1-128 (formerly EAN/UCC-128), GS1 DataBar (RSS-14),  EAN 13 & UPC, Postal (USPS, British Royal Mail, Australia Post, DHL, etc.), Data Matrix (including GS1 version), QR Code, PDF 417, UPS MaxiCode, Micro QR Code, ALL EAN/UPC Composite Barcodes (CC-A, CC-B & CC-C), Chinese Han Xin Code, IFA PPN, Postmatrix and many more!
releaseNotes:
● New! Added support for OS Clipboard so items can be shared between other editor instances (same process/MDI or another application). New `ClipboardMode` prop of type `EditorClipboardMode` (`Internal` or `System`).
● New! Added Item Index to the tooltip info. Customized through the `ItemIndexToolTipForeColor` prop.
● New! Adorner legends text color and font customization. Added props: `AdornerLegendsFontFamily` (WPF), `AdornerLegendsFontName` (WinForms), `AdornerLegendsFontSize` and `AdornerLegendsForeColor`.
● New! Duplex label design with 180-degree flip animation. New icon for flipping the page, customized with the props: `DuplexFlipColor` and `DuplexFlipHoverColor`.
● New! Duplex legends "Front Side" and "Back Side" color customization through the prop: `DuplexLegendsColor`.
● New! Duplex design related API: `DuplexSide` enum, `FlipDuplexSide()` method, `ActiveDuplexSide` prop, `ActiveDuplexSideChanged` event, `DuplexOutOfBoundsPolicy` enum, `DuplexOutOfBoundsHandling` prop, `ValidateOutOfLabelItems()` method, `GetDuplexItemsOutOfBounds()` method, `DuplexItemSideChanged` and `DuplexItemsOutOfBounds` events.
● New! Added a tray tied to the label canvas to hold non-visual items like `RFIDTagItem` and `LiteralItem`. Customized through props: `TrayBackColor`, `TrayBorderColor`, `TrayFrameGap`, and `TrayIconSize`.
● New! Added vector image support for `RFIDTagItem` through props: `RFIDTagVectorIconData` and `RFIDTagVectorIconColor`.
● New! Added `LiteralImageFileName` prop to specify the icon/image that will identify a `LiteralItem` on the new label tray.
● New! Added vector image support for `LiteralItem` through props: `LiteralVectorIconData` and `LiteralVectorIconColor`.
● New! Added JSON save/load support for every color-, image- and icon-related property of `ThermalLabelEditor`. New `SaveAppearanceSettings()` and `LoadAppearanceSettings()` methods.
● New! Now the `ImageProcessingDpi` prop defaults to zero (Auto), which resolves it automatically based on the zoom, the monitor scale factor and the resolution of each source image.
● New! Added the `ImageProcessingMonochromeDpi` prop, which improves the `ConvertToMonochrome` effect on the design surface.
● New! Added support for Rectangle and Ellipse label shapes.
● Improved! Performance when moving selected items. Added new events: `SelectionTransformStarted` and `SelectionTransformEnded`.
● Improved! Snapping to nearby items.
summary: First-class barcode label designer component for .NET Core Windows desktop apps (WinForms & WPF) which empowers your own apps by providing an end-user visual label editor.
title: Visual ThermalLabel Editor for .NET Core Windows Desktop
